scientific_role: AtomGit-specific downstream action-budget qualification and estimand amendment
motivation: AtomCode 5.0.9 does not expose a supported temperature control. Therefore the original Qwen397 temperature=0 writer/binder and temperature=0.2 shadow/final settings cannot be represented as equivalent treatments. Q0.3 qualifies a strict MiniSWEAgent ordinary-JSON text bridge at max_tokens=32768, while the older pre-bridge first-action qualification selected 2048. Q0.6 prospectively selects the smallest output ceiling that supports the exact Q0.3 bridge fixtures and freezes a conditional-on-realized-state estimand for provider-managed sampling before scientific writer/binder/shadow execution.

action_budget_qualification.fixtures: the exact 12 Q0.3 target MiniSWEAgent conversations, byte-equivalent by messages_sha256
action_budget_qualification.selection_rule: choose the first candidate with 12/12 PASS; do not execute larger candidates after PASS
per_fixture_pass: outer JSON parses as exactly assistant_message:string
assistant_message has THOUGHT and exactly one MiniSWEAgent fenced bash action

sampling_diagnostic.required_for_transport_validity: all 12 calls must be provider/bridge-valid; action diversity itself is descriptive and may be zero
sampling_diagnostic.purpose: characterize the empirical provider-managed first-action distribution under the exact downstream bridge

downstream_state_generation.writer: For each pilot unit and each SUCCESSFUL_SI/FAILED_SI branch, generate exactly one provider-managed writer draw using the Q0.4 plain-text JSON bridge and Q0.5 max_tokens=4096. Persist and content-address the realized memory before any binder or action sampling. A provider-valid writer draw is never rerolled for semantic preference.
downstream_state_generation.binder: For each pilot unit, branch, and G0_STEP0/GPLUS_MATCHED_REVEAL context, generate exactly one provider-managed binder draw using the Q0.4 plain-text JSON bridge and Q0.5 max_tokens=2048. Persist and content-address the realized bound state before any shadow sampling. A provider-valid binder draw is never rerolled for semantic preference.
downstream_state_generation.interpretation: Writer and binder stochasticity are part of the realized persistent/bound state. This pilot conditions on those realized content-addressed states; it does not estimate an average causal effect over writer/binder randomness.

downstream_action_estimand.sampling: All shadow and final first-action calls use the Q0.3 action JSON bridge, the Q0.6 selected action max_tokens, timeout=900, zero wrapper retries, and provider-managed sampling. No temperature equivalence claim is made.
downstream_action_estimand.action_signature: exact first fenced bash command; no post-hoc canonicalization
downstream_action_estimand.within_condition_noise: WS/WF are empirical block-to-block TVs conditional on the frozen writer/binder states
downstream_action_estimand.between_branch_transport: B1/B2 are empirical success-vs-failure branch TVs conditional on the frozen realized states
downstream_action_estimand.scientific_scope: state-conditional mechanism pilot, not a temperature-matched replication of Qwen397 and not a confirmatory model-level average

final_if_gate_passes.endpoint: per-unit empirical TV between success-writer and failure-writer first-action distributions conditional on the already-frozen realized states
pilot_pass_thresholds: positive D_select unit count > negative count

forbidden: reroll a provider-valid writer or binder state because of semantic preference
change action budget after scientific shadow outcomes
change block/sample counts after scientific shadow outcomes
change gate thresholds after scientific shadow outcomes
use fresh3 source task text in Q0.6 qualification fixtures
